chunks: And with this chain of transmission:

That two slave-girls were brought before ʿAlī عليه السلام; they had entered the bathhouse, and one of them injured the other with her finger, so he ruled that the indemnity against the one who had done it was her compensation-payment.

key_terms.الْإِسْنَادِ: the chain of transmission referred to from the previous report
key_terms.فَأَفْضَتْ: she caused injury or damage reaching the private part/body

ai.seo_question: What did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام rule when one girl injured another in the bathhouse?
ai.summary: This report relates a legal judgment of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام concerning bodily injury inflicted by one girl upon another in a bathhouse. It indicates liability for compensation in cases of harm to bodily organs or functions and reflects the Imam’s role in adjudicating injury claims.
